claims.statement: The manual note describes the most recent CodeQL CLI release at the source snapshot and links releases; installed older releases may expose different options, inspectable through their help. This is version-specific documentation, not current-release verification, installed compatibility or authority to execute upstream tooling.

The test-pack example depends on my-custom-queries using caret 1.2.3, described as at least 1.2.3 and below 2.0.0. Its actual extractor value is java-kotlin while prose calls it Java; preserve the value rather than substituting java. tests dot discovers all pack QL files only with strict-test-discovery when test run is invoked. Typically omitting version is described as preventing accidental publication, not a verified access-control gate or absolute guarantee. Example identities are placeholders; no pack was installed, tested or published.
